title: Swarmlite Gateway response cache
description: Route-level settings for Swarmlite's native Caddy HTTP cache handler and managed SQLite response store.

ttl.description: How long a stored response remains fresh.

methods.description: Optional method allowlist. When omitted, every ordinary HTTP method is cacheable; CONNECT and protocol upgrades always bypass the cache.

max_cacheable_body_bytes.description: Maximum response body captured for one cache entry.

max_request_body_bytes.description: Maximum request body hashed into a cache key; larger requests bypass the cache.

key_headers.description: Request headers always included in the variant key, in addition to fields named by the origin response's Vary header.

status_codes.description: Response status codes eligible for storage.
